_universe_note: HIGH-BETA / HIGH-RISK tilt: every name has beta >= 1.3 vs SPY (computed over 2y), annualized vol ~35-98%. No defensives, no index ETFs, no daily-leveraged ETFs (they decay over multi-day swing holds). Expect bigger swings and more frequent stop-outs — guardrails (stops, $50 cap, daily-loss breaker) are intentionally kept.

news._mode_help: off=ignore | alert=watchlist+log only | filter=block buys on negative news (default) | autonomous=allow news to trigger buys (NOT recommended; restricted to universe+tradable+caps)

risk._settlement_note: Cash account: buys are capped at broker buying_power (settled funds) so good-faith violations cannot occur. T+1 settlement naturally prevents redeploying same-day sale proceeds. max_trades_per_day is a runaway guard, not a target.
